notes.title: We are now supporting all languages available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Today we finished the work to support every possible language on Steam! There has been a lot of effort going into this, and we've done our best to ensure the quality of the translations. However, some of these languages have been more difficult in doing so than others, so please tell us if anything sounds a bit off to you when playing, and we'll do our best to correct it accordingly.

Thanks for your patience until the game is done, and thank you for enabling us to provide a good experience!
